headline:
Showroom shine,
at your driveway.
intro: Interior and exterior detailing for Nashville and Davidson County, at your door or at our Lewis St. office. Never had a detail before? We walk you through it and give you a free estimate.

mobile.title: Your driveway is our shop.
mobile.intro: We bring the detail to you, so your day keeps moving.

points.name: House calls
points.text: We make house calls with our mobile detailing service, or you can come to our office.

points.name: Free estimate
points.text: We inspect your car with you first, then price it for your vehicle.

points.name: Around Nashville
points.text: Nashville, Franklin, Brentwood, Green Hills, Belle Meade, Bellevue and more.

points.name: Easy to book
points.text: Call, email or send the form. We are open Monday to Saturday.

servicesTitle: Three details. One clear price each.
servicesIntro: Start with an interior detail. Add what your car needs.

services.name: Interior Detail
services.text: Vacuum, steam-cleaned carpet, fabric and leather, stain treatment, and protectant on leather, vinyl and plastic.

services.name: Exterior Detail
services.text: Hand wash, bug and tar removal, clay bar, wheels and tires cleaned, and a paint sealant that lasts 3 to 6 months.

services.name: Full Detail
services.text: Everything in the interior and exterior details, done in one visit.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.text: Machine polishing and compounding, with wet sanding if needed, to take paint to near perfection.

services.name: Ceramic Paint Coating
services.text: Long-term paint protection, with options from 1 year to 7 years.

services.name: Express Detail
services.text: A good cleaning and lasting protection for a new or well-maintained car, truck or SUV.

why.name: Air Force One team
why.text: Dr. Detail was hand picked for the team that details the President's Air Force One aircraft.

why.name: Certified and trained
why.text: Certified Skills Verified Detailer with the International Detailers Association, with ongoing training for the whole team.

why.name: Top-tier products
why.text: Professional detailing products and equipment, for a car that looks like the day it left the dealership.

whyTitle: The detail is in the name.
howTitle: A clean vehicle in three steps.

steps.name: Request a consultation
steps.text: Call or fill out the form. Consultations are free.

steps.name: Get your quote
steps.text: We price by your vehicle's size, condition and needs.

steps.name: Pick up your car
steps.text: Detailed, protected and ready for the big reveal.

reviews.text: His job on my car paint correction and ceramic coating was unbelievable! I would highly recommend his services on any exotic car.
